body: Started at 11; Graham-Newman; Partnership 1957–69 ~23.8%/yr net (no mgmt fee, 25% over 6%). Sanborn Map ~25% of assets 1958; Dempster 70% owned; AmEx 1964 salad-oil scuttlebutt. Korea picks 2004–05. 1951 return 75.8%. ~99% of wealth after 60–65. Mistakes: Berkshire textiles, Dexter Shoe, airlines 2020.
title: Warren Buffett
